posts.title_en: [Info] How steeply stage recommended power rises
posts.summary_en: Two charts over all 7,440 stages (1-1 to 248-30) of recommendedPower. Chart 1: the linear curve is a hockey stick ending at 248-30 = 2.00G, with 169~248 shaded as a fixed +2.94% per chapter. Chart 2: per-chapter growth versus the previous chapter's stage 30: 51~67 +5.40%, 68~87 +2.90%, 88~107 +1.74%, 112~168 +1.05% (lowest), then 169~248 re-accelerates to a fixed +2.94%.
mechanics: Chart 1 title: '권장 파워 곡선 — 1-1 부터 248-30 까지'. Caption: '7,440개 스테이지 전체의 recommendedPower. 로그 축에서 직선 = 일정한 배율 성장이므로, 기울기가 곧 가파름입니다. 선형 축으로 바꾸면 마지막 80개 챕터가 전체를 삼키는 하키스틱이 됩니다.' End label: '248-30 · 2.00G'. Shaded band: '169~248장 · 챕터당 +2.94% 고정'.

Chart 2 title: '챕터당 증가율 — 직전 챕터 30스테이지 대비 (50장~)'. Caption: '가파름의 상대 지표. 49장 이전은 편차가 커서 제외했습니다. 계단식으로 둔화하다가 112~168장에서 +1.05%로 바닥을 찍고, 169장부터 +2.94%로 고정 재가속합니다. 평평한 구간은 기획된 고정 배율 구간입니다.' Note: '49장 이전 제외 (증가율 +1.0% ~ +65.5%로 편차가 큼)'. Step labels: 51~67장 +5.40%; 68~87장 +2.90%; 88~107장 +1.74%; 112~168장 +1.05% (최저); 169~248장 +2.94% 재가속. A spike near chapters 108-111 is unlabelled.
Comment: at +3% a further 80-chapter expansion would need 10x the pre-expansion power (1.03^80).
Comments tie the steep curve to the reward cut above 169 ('권장투력 2g인데 보상은 반에반에반에반토막'); '175이후부턴 개씹지옥'.

quotes.kr: 원래 30스테기준으로 직전챕터랑 1%차이나던게 이젠 3배인 3%씩 차이나니깐 그래프저지랄남
quotes.en: Stage 30 used to differ from the previous chapter's by 1%; now it's 3x that, 3% each, hence the graph.

quotes.kr: 앞으로도 3%로 80스테확장하면 딱 확장전 투력에서 10배필요함 1.03^80
quotes.en: If they expand another 80 chapters at 3%, you need exactly 10x the pre-expansion power (1.03^80).

posts.title_en: [Info] 비겁이 guide for newbies
posts.summary_en: Three-step 비겁이 method: run in to apply the ATK-down debuff and stack poison, follow him when he moves and keep stacking, then let go and watch. Everyone must receive 우유's buff; move before 시커 plants for damage. Image shows the power-gate tool for 72-30 (비겁한 쿠키 x1, recommended 47M 738K) with every bracket threshold; the author cleared at 35%. A commenter cleared 40-30 at 35% with it; the author adds a 쫄쿨민 deck and pets.

clears.note: '35퍼 보정클리어'; 35% bracket starts at ≥19M 96K for this stage.
Commenter using this method.

quotes.en: 1. Run in, apply ATK-down and stack poison. 2. When 비겁이 moves, follow and keep stacking. 3. Let go and watch it die.

posts.title_en: [Q] Recommended gear options
posts.summary_en: At 84-15 (44M 637K, stage preset) a cape with 치명저항 8.53% + HP +1,671 shows 3.99M power while one with HP +1,824 + DEF +132 shows 2.82M (-1.17M). Answers: on armour just take the higher power; on weapon/accessories take 명중/집중; options matter from about chapter 190; 'stages are 명중, 집중, power'.

builds.gear: Armour: highest power; weapon and accessories: 명중/집중 substats. Before ~190 just take power.
builds.why: Crit-res substat inflates displayed power (3.99M vs 2.82M on the same Lv 56 unique cape).

mechanics: Substat choice moves displayed power a lot: 치명저항 8.53% cape 3.99M vs HP/DEF cape 2.82M.

quotes.kr: 기억해라 스테는 명중 집중 투력
quotes.en: Remember: for stages it's accuracy, focus, power.

In-game effect at roughly ≥300% of recommended power: the progress gauge burns and the boss does a frightened somersault (poster's estimate). Boss retry button unchanged.

disagreements: Poster thinks the cue should appear from ~150%; commenters note the effect appeared early in the game too.

posts.title_kr: 비응신 같은 조합으로 55 맞춰서 비겁이 깸
posts.title_en: Cleared 비겁이 by reaching 55% with a silly combo
posts.summary_en: After failing 비겁이 at 35% with 람짱's deck, the poster built a power-inflated deck (669.13M) to reach the 55% bracket and cleared. 람짱: at 55% damage is enough and survival is the issue; two defensive pets plus the 3-tank perk remove the need for another healer. 명랑 can't be dropped: without it 허브 gets one-shot and 우유 dies right after.

teams.name: 55% 뻥투력 비겁이 deck
teams.why: Inflate power (뻥투력) to cross into 55% where damage is enough; defensive pets and tank perk cover survival.
unorthodox: Deliberately chasing the 55% bracket with power-padding picks instead of grinding 35%

mechanics: At 55% damage is sufficient; survival is the constraint (람짱).
Tactic: when infinite 35% retries fail, pad power into 55% ('가끔 35로 무한 트라이 하다가 안되면 어거지로 55 맞춰서 깨는 것도 괜찮은듯'); 람짱 used high-star 밀키 for padding near 55%.
disagreements: 람짱 thought the deck could run at 35% and drop 명랑; poster found removing 명랑 gets 허브 one-shot and 우유 killed.

quotes.kr: 원래 55%는 딜 충분하니까 몸이 문젠건데 방어형 2펫에 3방어 복지도 쓰면 되니까 힐러도 더 안넣어도 되고 투력도 올릴수있고
quotes.en: At 55% damage is enough; the body is the problem, but with two defensive pets and the 3-tank perk you don't need another healer and you can raise power.

quotes.kr: 이게 명랑을 빼게 되면 허브가 한 방컷이 나버리면서 우유도 바로 죽어버령
quotes.en: If you take out 명랑, 허브 gets one-shot and 우유 dies right away.

posts.title_en: My 35% 비겁이 deck
posts.summary_en: Text deck for 비겁이 at 35%: 브시커 전갈 치케 석류 피겨 정전 라임 우유 들개 이온 허브 닼초. Damage just needs a lucky high roll; the problem is survival, which needs the 초코왕방울 DMG-reduction pet and the 10% DMG-reduction perk.

teams.name: 68686 35% 비겁이 deck (text)
teams.why: Damage relies on high rolls; survival needs DMG-reduction pet and perk.

quotes.kr: 딜은 뽀록 터지면 된다치는데 문제는 초코왕방울 피감펫에 복지 피감 10%까지 땡겨야 안뒤지더라
quotes.en: Damage works if you get lucky; the problem is you need the 초코왕방울 DMG-reduction pet and the 10% DMG-reduction perk not to die.

posts.title_kr: 명집 안 챙기는 애들 궁금한 점
posts.title_en: A question for those who skip accuracy/focus
posts.summary_en: Poster states each 100 accuracy below a stage's requirement adds 10% misses, and 248-30's requirement is 1200; someone claimed a 35% clear with under 700 accuracy. Replies: without accuracy you'd go 55% (power-padded) instead; a 35% clear without accuracy means 12 hours of retries or a lie; one says accuracy can follow power but focus is a must; stage matters; nobody who claims 800 명집 states their power.

clears.note: Second-hand claim: cleared with accuracy under 700; screenshot reportedly existed, not linked.

builds.thresholds: 248-30 accuracy requirement 1200 (poster); −10% hit per 100 below requirement

mechanics: Accuracy: each 100 below the stage requirement = +10% miss chance (poster: '명중 요구치에서 100 모자랄 때마다 10% 빗방'); 248-30 requirement 1200. At <700 more than half the attacks miss.
disagreements: Skeptics: a 35% clear without accuracy is '12 hours of retries or a lie'; theoretically possible only with no misses and every debuff landing.
'명은투력대로 집으면되고 충분하다. 그런데 집은 꼭 집고가라' — accuracy can just follow power, but focus is mandatory.
'캔디애플': the 앵그리버드 (pet) pushes well; hasn't tried 35%.

quotes.kr: 명중 요구치에서 100 모자랄 때마다 10% 빗방 나는데 248-30 기준치 1200인데
quotes.en: Each 100 short of the accuracy requirement gives 10% misses, and 248-30's requirement is 1200.

quotes.kr: 명중버리고 55퍼단 하면 가능인데 명중도 좆박고 35퍼 깻다고 하는거면 12시간 박앗거나 구라임
quotes.en: Dropping accuracy works if you're a 55%-er, but claiming a 35% clear with trash accuracy means 12 hours of retries or a lie.

quotes.kr: 알려준다 명은투력대로 집으면되고 충분하다. 그런데 집은 꼭 집고가라 집 없으면 엄청 힘듬
quotes.en: Here's the thing: pick accuracy by power and that's enough. But you must take focus; without focus it's very hard.

posts.title_en: The 35% crew really does need accuracy/focus
posts.summary_en: 람짱 at stage 250 dropped accuracy from 1150 to 930: many misses, and a missed skill costs a lot of damage; when skills don't miss the team auto-clears, when they do it fails. Reply: if your power sits exactly at the 35% cut accuracy/focus don't matter (나나리); 람짱 disagrees and will get an accuracy item. 나나리's growth stalled in the mid-280s due to plates.

clears.note: 명중 930 (down from 1150): frequent skill misses.

builds.thresholds: 명중 1150 fine at 250; 930 causes frequent skill misses

mechanics: Skill misses are what cost 35% clears: '스킬 미스 안뜨면 자동으로 밀리고 미스 많이 뜨면 안밀린다'.
disagreements: 나나리: at exactly the 35% power line, 명집 doesn't matter — take power. 람짱: at that line you should take high accuracy.

quotes.kr: 스킬 미스 안뜨면 자동으로 밀리고 미스 많이 뜨면 안밀린다
quotes.en: If skills don't miss it auto-clears; if lots miss it doesn't.

quotes.kr: 35딱투력이면 명집알빠노임
quotes.en: If you're right at the 35% power line, who cares about accuracy/focus.

posts.title_kr: 스테이지 명중집중 어느정도로 하면 되는지 딱 정리좀
posts.title_en: How much accuracy/focus for stages, exactly?
posts.summary_en: At 195 with 920/920. Replies: one pushes 230 at 900-1100; another at 250-260 held 1200/1200, then from ~240 dropped to ~950/950 in favour of power-inflating eternal gear with no trouble — but pushes at 55%, and says for 35% over 1000 looks safe.

builds.gear: eternal (이터널) gear chosen for power over 명집 from ~240

quotes.kr: 35%로 밀기 귀찮아서 55%로만 밀고 있어서 35%할거면 1000 넘기는게 안전해보임
quotes.en: I push only at 55% since 35% is a hassle; if you do 35%, over 1000 seems safe.

posts.title_kr: [📚정보] 내 기준 암살자 가장 잘잡는 조합
posts.title_en: [Info] My best combination for the Assassin
posts.summary_en: 270-18 (레드베리 암살자) cleared at 1G 395M; to hit the power cut the author inflated power, leaving accuracy ~950 (79% hit rate). Pets 갓방울, 핫도그, 연타; perks 열정페이 + 초고속승진; attack order 우유, 시커, 피겨. Tip: don't start on arrival at 7 o'clock — wait until enough assassins are pulled in, but not so long that time runs out. A commenter notes 우유's buff is missed for ~3 s in the video.

clears.note: Power padded to reach the bracket cut; 명중 ~950 (명중률 ~79%).

teams.name: 러유 암살자 조합
teams.why: Pull the assassins together before starting.

mechanics: At 270-18, accuracy ~950 gave ~79% hit rate (author).
stage_types: 레드베리 암살자 (12 per crumblehub index): start only once the assassins have been drawn in; starting too late runs out of time.

quotes.kr: 7시 도착하자마자 시작하지 말고 충분히 암살자 땡겼다 싶으면 시작
quotes.en: Don't start as soon as you reach 7 o'clock; start once you've pulled enough assassins.

posts.title_en: Skill haste matters on stages too
posts.summary_en: Replies: pull about three skill-haste lines on gear for uptime and buff duration; another runs all skill haste plus as much accuracy as possible, and 전갈 then reaches 20 stacks against 비겁이 without 정전.

builds.gear: about 3 skill-haste (스가) lines on gear; or all 스가 + max 명중
builds.why: Uptime and buff duration; 전갈 hits 20 stacks on 비겁이 without 정전.

quotes.kr: 그냥 올 스가 + 최대한 명중 챙기기 하니까 좋던데 비겁이 잡을때 전갈 20스택이 정전 없이 그냥 잘 쌓임
quotes.en: All skill haste plus as much accuracy as I can works well; against 비겁이 전갈 stacks to 20 without 정전.

posts.title_en: Wish power counted accuracy up to 1200 more
posts.summary_en: One-line wish that accuracy up to 1200 were weighted more in team power (so taking accuracy wouldn't cost bracket).
mechanics: Implied: accuracy substats add little to displayed power, so 명중 competes with bracket power.

posts.title_en: Is crit resistance useless on stages?
posts.summary_en: Replies: on stages options barely matter — just watch accuracy/focus and power. The asker feels attack options do matter.
disagreements: Replier: options barely matter on stages beyond 명집 and power; asker: attack options seem to make a sizable difference.

quotes.kr: 스테는 명집 투력만 봐도 된다니까
quotes.en: For stages you only need to look at accuracy/focus and power.

posts.title_en: 227-10 35% 체콜 deck
posts.summary_en: 227-10 cleared at 35% in 3 tries at 602.79M with a deck copied from the gallery. Method: the first attack kills 닥초, the second kills 감초's minions; before the third, move into the centre to split damage, and keep the team from scattering. Mercenary Lv 4 reached today with perks 열정페이 (highest-ATK ally +20% ATK, −20% max HP) and 크런치 모드 (two lowest-HP allies +15% ATK, −10% max HP).

clears.note: The three-attack sequence matches the bikers.

teams.name: 쥐돌이련 체콜덱

cookies.note: dark cloaked figure with a scythe; possibly 감초 (text mentions 감초's minions)
white/teal ghostly lady with a hat
dies to the first attack by design

teams.why: 닥초 and 감초's minions absorb the first two biker attacks; then stack in the centre to spread the third.

mechanics: Perk texts (screenshot): 열정페이 '공격력 가장 높은 아군 공격력 20% 증가, 최대체력 20% 감소'; 크런치 모드 '최대체력 낮은 아군 2명 공격력 15% 증가, 최대체력 10% 감소'. Mercenary Lv 4 '베테랑 용병단': '복지 선택 1개 추가', '거대화 광속질주 활성화'.
stage_types: 바이커 (3-attack pattern): let 닥초 take the first hit and summons take the second; move into the centre before the third to split damage; keep the team from spreading.

quotes.kr: 첫타에 닥초 죽이고 두번째에 감초 쫄들 죽고 세번째 공격 하기전에 중심으로 들어가서 딜분산
quotes.en: First hit kills 닥초, second kills 감초's minions; before the third attack move to the centre to spread the damage.

posts.title_en: Low accuracy slows stage pushing
posts.summary_en: With low accuracy bosses were fine but mob waves dragged (~3 minutes felt). Replies: later bosses suffer too — keep accuracy 1100+; poster raised 678 → 900s; another at 700 found pushing slow; an accuracy-100 pet alone speeds it up.
mechanics: Low accuracy mainly slows the trash-mob section; later bosses also suffer.
A pet with 명중 +100 noticeably speeds mob waves.
stage_types: Mob (쫄/잡몹) sections are the most accuracy-sensitive at mid stages.

quotes.kr: 후반엔 보스도 문제생김 명중은 1100이상 하는게 좋음
quotes.en: Later, bosses become a problem too; accuracy 1100+ is good.

posts.title_en: Do I have to swap decks for every boss?
posts.summary_en: At 262 each of 262-1/-2/-3 needs a different setup. A reply keeps four presets: 1) 3-4-enemy deck, 2) many-enemy deck, 3) 쿨링/얼음/망치 jump deck, 4) 비겁. Swapping to the panda pet is tedious.
stage_types: Preset layout (갓갓.): 1 = 3-4 enemies, 2 = many enemies, 3 = 쿨링민트 / 얼음 (골렘) / 망치 jumping bosses, 4 = 비겁.

quotes.kr: 그냥 난 1번 3-4마리덱 2번 다수덱 3번 쿨링이나 얼음 망치 점프덱 4번 비겁
quotes.en: I just use: 1 for 3-4 enemies, 2 for many, 3 for 쿨링/ice/hammer jumpers, 4 for 비겁.

posts.summary_en: 235-10 폭주단 바이커 cleared at 35% at 694M 583K (player Devil, Lv 164, 축복 Lv 3, oven Lv 31, preset 1) with 5.233 on the timer, after being stuck since 6 pm the previous day. Ten cookies alive (Lv 99-100), two dead.

quotes.kr: 이겜이 다 운빨이지 뭐..
quotes.en: This game is all luck anyway.

posts.title_en: Everyone does this on 35% mob stages, right?
posts.summary_en: For 35% mob stages the poster removes 허브, 들개 and 닥초 and adds 연타 cookies and 치케. Replies disagree: some keep 허브 and 닥초; one drops 들개 and 허브 and adds 정전 — no deaths and more damage.
stage_types: 35% mob (잡몹) stages: cut tank/heal (허브, 들개, 닥초) for 연타 damage and 치케; variant drops 들개 + 허브, adds 정전.
disagreements: Whether to drop 허브: poster drops it; replies '허브를 빼?', '허브 닼초는 넣는데?'; another drops 들개 and 허브 and adds 정전.

quotes.kr: 들개 허브 빼버림. 대신 정전 넣음
quotes.en: I drop 들개 and 허브 and put in 정전 instead.
